prompt.text:
Implement `Solution.java` with a public final class `Solution`. Define a public nested record `Message(long id, long authorId, String body)` and a public static method `List<Message> append(List<Message> existing, List<Message> incoming, int batchLimit)`. The method returns a new list containing all existing messages followed by at most the first `batchLimit` incoming messages. IDs must be unique across both retained and appended messages; otherwise throw `IllegalArgumentException`. Reject null lists, null elements, non-positive IDs, null bodies, and `batchLimit < 0` with `IllegalArgumentException`. An empty body is valid. A zero limit appends nothing and therefore does not validate ignored incoming elements. Preserve encounter order. Return an unmodifiable list that does not alias either input list; later mutations of the inputs must not affect it. Do not mutate the inputs.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
